heading: Effective date of insurance
lead: Insurance may be made effective, as specified in the application, not later than the first day of the calendar month following the date of application therefor, but the United States shall not be liable thereunder for death occurring before such effective date.

notes.heading: Amendments
notes.text: 1991—Pub. L. 102–83 renumbered section 709 of this title as this section.
